t: How Many Days Rich Are You? | InvestorPlace
s: March 10, 2025 - You pay school bills (either yours or a child’s). You also buy groceries and go out to eat a few times a month. These expenses add up to $100,000 per year. Oh, and if you stop working today, you and your family would have no money coming in. In this example, you’re basically 730 Days Rich (or 2 years rich).
